quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Anytime to take a cool sip and feel refreshed"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: This helps your body feel cool and full of energy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Drinking water helps us feel refreshed all day long.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to get ready to head out the door"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You do this right after breakfast, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: Yes! We get dressed in the morning before we head out for the day.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to close your eyes for a short, restful sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: A soft blanket and a quiet room help with this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A short nap helps us feel refreshed for the rest of the day.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to slip on your favorite pair before school"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Your feet need this before running, walking, or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on shoes is one of the last steps before we leave home.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to cover your toes before your shoes go on"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: They can be striped, spotted, or your favorite color.
quests.explanation: That's right! Socks keep our toes cozy all day long.
quests.funFact: Matching two socks together can be a fun little puzzle every morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to make your playroom neat again after playtime"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: Toy bins or shelves are where these things end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clean up our toys after playtime to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: A tidy playroom gives you more space to run, build, and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to keep your body cool and full of energy"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: You often do this after running or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Water is what our busy bodies need to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to feel bright, clean, and ready for the day"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You gently pat dry with a towel once you finish this.
quests.explanation: Correct! Washing our face is one of the first things we do each morning.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to sit at the table and eat something yummy"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This is usually the last meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Correct! We gather for dinner in the evening before getting ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to make everything dark and quiet for bedtime"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: A small switch on the wall helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We turn off the light at night to make our room cozy for sleep.
quests.funFact: Some children like a soft night light to keep a little glow in the dark!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to rinse away germs before you eat"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: You do this before meals and after playing outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our hands with soap keeps us healthy.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to review what you learned in class that day"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: A pencil and a quiet space help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We do homework in the afternoon to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Finding a quiet, comfy spot can make homework time easier to focus on!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth strong and healthy"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You use a small brush and a dab of toothpaste for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We brush our teeth in the morning and at night to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to get snuggly and warm before bed"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You wear these all night until morning comes.
quests.explanation: Correct! We change into pajamas at night, right before we go to sleep.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to nibble on something yummy before dinner"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: You enjoy this between lunch and dinner.
quests.explanation: Well done! A healthy snack helps keep our energy up until dinner.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to ride along a route that ends at school"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: A big, often yellow vehicle carries you for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We ride the bus in the morning to get to school safely.
quests.funFact: Riding the bus with friends is a fun way to start the school day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to rest your body with a little quiet sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This happens in the middle of the day, not at night.
quests.explanation: Well done! Napping gives our busy bodies a little extra rest.
quests.funFact: A short nap can help you feel happier and more focused afterward!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to play with bubbles and get nice and clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: This washes away the whole day's dirt in one splash.
quests.explanation: Correct! We take a bath in the evening to get ready for a cozy night's sleep.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to take a break and enjoy a sandwich or snack"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: You often eat this at school, between classes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating lunch helps us feel ready for afternoon fun and learning.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime is a great time to chat and laugh with your friends!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to put away what you wore so your room stays neat"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: A hook or a hanger is where these end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our clothes to keep our room neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: A tidy closet makes it much easier to pick an outfit in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get your hair looking neat before school"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: It helps you look neat and tidy before school.
quests.explanation: Correct! We comb our hair each morning to get ready for the day.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to walk along the sidewalk toward your school"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You use your own two feet for this journey.
quests.explanation: Yes! We walk to school in the morning to get to our classroom.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to give your body fuel before school"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: This is the very first meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat breakfast in the morning to get energy for the day.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to greet the day with a big stretch and a smile"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: This is the very first thing you do each morning, right after you stop dreaming.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wake up in the morning to start our fun new day.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to enjoy a calm story before bedtime"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: Pages, pictures, and a good story are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We read a book in the evening to relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Some children love hearing the very same favorite story again and again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to get comfy and drift off to sleep"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: You climb under soft blankets for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We go to bed at night to rest our busy bodies.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to help get everything ready before the family eats"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: Plates, cups, and forks are placed down for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set the table before dinner so everyone can sit and eat.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to leave your bed looking neat and tidy"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You smooth out sheets and fluff a pillow for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We make our bed in the morning to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to share a gentle goodbye before the lights go off"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this to your family right before you close your eyes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good night to share a kind goodbye before we sleep.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to fill your bag with books before school"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You carry this on your back all the way to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing our backpack means gathering books and supplies for the day.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!
